newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN envoy to visit Croatia after Mostar attack.
newsitem.headline: UN envoy to visit Croatia after Mostar attack.

text.p: The U.N. human rights envoy for former Yugoslavia will visit Bosnia and Croatia, including the city of Mostar where one person died and 22 were wounded when Bosnian Croats opened fire on Moslems visiting a cemetery.

Elisabeth Rehn, the U.N. special rapporteur (investigator) for human rights, will also go to Vukovar and the Croatian capital Zagreb during her visit to the region on February 16-22, a U.N. spokesman said.
Rehn this week held the Croatian government responsible for upholding the rights of Mostar's citizens and called on Bosnian Croats to remove from power those responsible for the violence on Monday.
Zagreb is seen as standing behind hard-line Bosnian Croats in Mostar who seek a separate state in the part of southwestern Bosnia under their control.
